Notes

The retirement plan is one quiet afternoon; Effie answers it with a restless, defiant voice from Seoul.

我想退休

退休 normally means retirement from working life, yet the imagined reward here is only an afternoon alone with milk tea. That disproportion makes the wish both funny and affecting: he asks for an exit from the whole system to obtain a very small amount of unclaimed time. The song repeats the fantasy instead of specifying a career plan.

  • Lyric transcript (the passage discussed here)
点杯奶茶

There is no grand scene of escape: just the everyday act of buying a sweet drink and being allowed to enjoy it alone. 独自享受 makes solitude a pleasure rather than a punishment. That small wish cuts through the tape’s recurring larger demands to make it big, earn money, be seen and keep going.

  • Lyric transcript (the passage discussed here)
鲜花早就枯萎

鲜花 names fresh flowers, immediately contradicted by 早就, “long since,” and 枯萎, “withered.” What sounds beautiful has already used up its life. The image lets the song move from a mildly comic retirement wish into a sense that the period for thriving has somehow been missed. No explanation of the loss follows.

  • Lyric transcript (the passage discussed here)
失踪的孩子们

The first-person fatigue suddenly opens onto an unspecified plural: children who have gone missing and have nowhere clear to go. The following narrow road sustains that disorientation. The lyric offers no incident or place to identify; its force comes from replacing the solitary adult seeking rest with people who cannot find a route at all.

  • Lyric transcript (the passage discussed here)
挤破了头

挤破头 means struggling so fiercely to squeeze into something that heads get battered. The narrow road makes opportunity spatial: even continuing forward requires competing for room. After the withered flowers and missing children, the familiar idiom becomes unusually physical. The exhaustion has a visible cause—too many people trying to fit where there is not enough space.

  • Lyric transcript (the passage discussed here)
吃力不讨好

吃力不讨好 means working hard without earning appreciation or a favorable response. 吃力 contributes the strain, 讨好 the attempt to please. It follows the pair 费心 and 费力, spending mental attention and bodily effort. The accumulating phrases distinguish being tired from refusing a bargain in which neither kind of effort seems to come back to you.

  • Lyric transcript (the passage discussed here)
오냐

오냐 is an affirmative response used to somebody younger or lower in status: closer to a familiar “all right” than a polite, neutral yes. Its repeated use gives Effie a rhythmically assertive entrance. The switch from Mandarin into Korean and then English marks a distinct voice taking over the song, with its own way of addressing the listener.

  • Chunjae Education: Korean-language workbook explanations
small like plankton

Plankton shrinks the self to something tiny and carried by surrounding currents. Effie moves almost immediately from that image into trouble-seeking, style and self-assertion. The boast does not neatly cancel the smallness; the verse keeps changing scale. That makes her response to Jackzebra’s fatigue active and restless without making it simply more optimistic.

  • Lyric transcript (the passage discussed here)
givenchy

Givenchy is the French fashion house; the line is a compressed outfit detail. It arrives between lying on a dirty street and insisting that nobody will ruin her work. Designer clothing does not clear away the verse’s smallness or disorder. It becomes one of the things she can still assert about herself while declaring independence from the industry.

  • Givenchy: the house
dance while i’m singing in the chaos

Jackzebra imagines stopping work and sitting alone; Effie tells the body to keep moving while disorder continues. The connective word is “while”: dancing does not have to wait for a calm or repaired life. This gives the feature a distinct answer to the same exhaustion, and the return of his retirement refrain leaves both answers in play.

  • Lyric transcript (the passage discussed here)
G-dragon

G-DRAGON is the Korean rapper and BIGBANG member. Naming somebody she misses interrupts Effie’s self-sufficient pose with fandom. The later “crayon” also sits beside a G-DRAGON title: his official tour release lists “Crayon.” That gives the drawing image a possible musical echo, while its immediate scene stays small and handmade, far from the industry she has just dismissed.

  • YG Entertainment: G-DRAGON artist release

About Jackzebra and this mixtape

Zhuang Zhuang Mixtape arrived on Surf Gang on October 2, 2026: 55 tracks, opening with Sour and closing with Sweet. Its cast widens from YoungQueenz on Poker Face to User116, Effie, kuru, yoyi, 春 and 南部犯罪份子. Aghast has a production credit on every track from Hitman through Snatch, giving that stretch a shared collaborator behind its changing scenes.

Surf Gang release · Artist credits

Jackzebra told AVYSS that he writes while singing over a beat he has listened to repeatedly, keeping the images in his head central. He values the room Mandarin leaves for indirect meanings. Listen for ordinary phrases becoming physical scenes: familiarity becomes cooking, authority becomes family seniority, and a tired saying suddenly turns into a threat.

AVYSS interview, 2024

In STATIC, he describes mixtapes as a format for letting ideas flow, reserving an official debut album for later. In a separate conversation about Above & Beyond, he compared that earlier tape to a collection of his producer friends’ work. The credits here likewise reward attention: long-running collaborators sit alongside guests working in Mandarin, Korean and English.

STATIC interview · Sabukaru interview, 2025

The small details connect to his stated interests: he has described playing Temple Run in transit and before shows, watching Top Boy, and wanting to score White Oleander. These give the songs specific points of contact with his life. The notes follow those connections alongside the lyrics’ jokes, invented scenes and competing voices.

His recommendations in Perfectly Imperfect · Dazed interview, 2025 · Interview questionnaire, 2025

Jackzebra has pushed back on being made to represent all of China’s underground. These notes stay close to the words: what an expression usually means, what changes in this line, and how another song answers it. Cultural references have sources; interpretations rest on details you can hear or read in the song.
